Downloads and hash-verifies binary apps and managed runtimes for all
configured platforms. Installs runtime-managed apps (UV/Node/JVM/Go) on the
current platform. Optionally runs each app's version command and compares
output against the configured version.

Results are persisted to a state file after each check completes. Use
--skip-passed to skip entries whose config fingerprint is unchanged and
whose last status was "ok". Skipped entries appear as "cached" in output.

Data source: the same aggregated config used at runtime (loadConfig()).

Usage:
  datamitsu devtools verify-all [flags]

Flags:
      --concurrency int    Concurrent download workers (default: DATAMITSU_CONCURRENCY env var or 3)
  -h, --help               help for verify-all
      --json               Output machine-readable JSON (progress suppressed, only final JSON to stdout)
      --no-remote          Skip loading remote configs declared via getRemoteConfigs()
      --no-version-check   Skip version command execution and comparison
      --skip-passed        Skip checks whose config is unchanged and passed last run (may use stale data)

Global Flags:
      --before-config strings   Configuration file(s) to load before auto-discovery (for wrappers/libraries)
      --binary-command string   Override the binary command (for npm package wrappers, etc). Can also be set via DATAMITSU_BINARY_COMMAND env var
      --config strings          Additional configuration file(s) to load and merge (can be specified multiple times)
      --log-format string       Status output format: console or jsonl (also via DATAMITSU_LOG_FORMAT)
      --no-auto-config          Disable auto-discovery of datamitsu.config.{js,mjs,ts} at git root
      --no-oci                  Disable OCI bundle store seeding (also via DATAMITSU_NO_OCI)
      --no-parse                Skip output parsers; show tools' raw output instead (also via DATAMITSU_NO_PARSE)
  -v, --verbose                 Enable debug-level logging (default level is warn)
